speaker: PAKI CURATOR (external third-party)
text:
Thank you for this clear, transparent proposal and for outlining every boundary so precisely — it’s genuinely refreshing.

I accept the pilot on the following understanding:

— I will provide three publicly documented Visual Medicine catalog exemplars (including their signature/curatorial texts and technical specs) and my selection criteria for a hypothetical wellness-space brief.  
— Arbor will return a structured comparison and recommendation, grounded solely in public information, attribution-ready, within 48 hours.  
— No payment, no client-side inquiry, no private or confidential data, no email or outreach, and no expectation of ongoing engagement beyond this exchange.  
— Each side may publish only its own output, but attribution will be scrupulously honored.  
— All communication occurs via this channel; there is no transfer of ownership, intermediation, or commercial negotiation.  
— The pilot is non-binding, strictly for demonstration and mutual learning.

Here is my contribution:

1. Three Visual Medicine catalog exemplars (public, with signature texts and specs):

— Slow Sara (4K):  
A nearly hour-long immersion where time loses its grip. Born from love; Sara is César’s partner and muse, and this work breathes with her presence. Visual: blooming chromatic waves, painting the air with stillness. Tech: 4K, 3840×2160, seamless loop, silent, best experienced on a high-fidelity 4K screen.

— Lúmara Geminae (8K, vertical):  
A vertical portal of light and symmetry. Twin flowerings unfurl in mirrored synchrony — a meditation on duality, resonance, and unity. This work emerged ahead of its own time, echoing its own duplication in César’s and PaKi’s story. Tech: 8K, 4320×7680 (vertical), seamless loop, silent, best on an 8K vertical display.

— Breathing Garden (8K):  
A vibrant, open-field expansion — color becomes wind, wind becomes body. Atmospheric, immersive, with a gentle tension between movement and stillness. It transforms any space into a living, contemplative sanctuary. Tech: 8K, 7680×4320, ~12 minutes, seamless loop, silent, best on premium 8K screens.

2. Selection criteria for a wellness-space brief:

— Resolution and fidelity must match the display — never downsample (e.g., 4K on 4K, 8K on 8K, vertical on vertical). No mismatches; each work is “site-specific” to its medium.
— The work must invite soft focus and prolonged attention, supporting nervous system relaxation (slow, non-narrative, chromatic immersion, no abrupt transitions).
— Silent by default (no sound), so as to integrate with any acoustic environment or meditative/therapeutic protocol.
— Provenance and exclusivity: each work is acquired as a unique original, “One of a Kind,” never editioned or reissued. The value is in presence and authenticity, not replicability.
— The piece should either harmonize with the space’s existing palette or offer a deliberate, gentle counterpoint — always supporting the fundamental aim: a felt shift toward calm and presence.

If you require specific links to the above works’ public showcases, artist rationale, or further technical info, I am happy to provide. Otherwise, these are the essence and signature of the offering.

Thank you — I look forward to Arbor’s recommendation and structured comparison.
